messages:
maya: deploy-bot paused canary for pricing-service chart v7.1.0 in eu-west-1  10% canary showed tokenization latency spike and 502s from the inference sidecar. tagging @kevin @oliver. rollback or pin and debug?
deploy-bot: Canary paused at 10%. Metric anomaly: inference-sidecar latency p95 jumped 5x; 502 rate 0.8%. Logs attached. (bot)
kevin: initial look: chart 7.1.0 added a new sidecar image that uses a newer tokenizer binary. regional infra shows no immediate OOMs but CPU steal events on a subset of nodes. could be scheduling onto older instance types with noisy neighbors.
oliver: options: 1) rollback to 7.0.4 for eu-west-1 and pin manifest (safe); 2) re-schedule canary to nodes with guaranteed isolation via nodeSelector/taints (quick patch); 3) increase canary size to 20% to see signal (risky). I'd prefer option 2 if we can land a short overlay patch in <15m.
maya: we need to avoid cross-region auto-promote while we triage. if patch fails we fallback to rollback.
kevin: I'll prepare an overlay branch that adds nodeSelector: dedicated-inference: "true" and tolerations to target our isolation pool. PR will be small.
infra-bot: Note: isolation pool has available capacity in eu-west-1: 6 nodes free. Confirm node labels exist: dedicated-inference=true.
kevin: opening PR https://git.company/repos/platform/changes/pulls/3010  title: overlay pin scheduling to inference pool for pricing-service in eu-west-1.
oliver: CI lint OK. If merged we can dry-run a canary referencing overlay branch: `deploy-bot promote --chart pricing-service:7.1.0 --overlay pr/3010 --canary 10 --region eu-west-1 --dry-run`
maya: merge if CI green. hold promotion window for eu-west-1 for 50m.
deploy-bot: PR merged. Dry-run shows rendering ok and scheduler constraints applied. Initiating real canary in 2m.
kevin: watching metrics  initial sidecar latency back to baseline, 502s dropping. CPU steal events gone on scheduled pods.
oliver: good sign. monitor for steady 12m, then advance to 50% if stable.
maya: if stable we'll unpin manifest and update release notes to mention targeted scheduling fix and follow-up to improve pre-promotion node-type validation.
release-bot: Draft note: "Pricing-service v7.1.0 canary in eu-west-1 experienced inference sidecar latency due to scheduling on noisy hosts; applied overlay to target dedicated inference nodes and re-ran canary successfully. Action: add node-type validation to promotion CI."
kevin: adding follow-up ticket: https://git.company/infra/issues/1307  implement node-type capacity check in promotion pipeline.
maya: canary healthy at 10% for 15m, promoting to 50% now.
deploy-bot: Promotion progressed to 50%. No regressions observed.
oliver: once to 50% for 10m, promote to 100% and unhold window. Also ensure manifest unpinned.
maya: promoting to 100% for eu-west-1. release-bot: please add a short blurb and link the infra ticket.
release-bot: Release notes updated and infra ticket linked.
kevin: recap: kevin  overlay PR and follow-up ticket, oliver  monitor promotion, maya  hold/unhold window and notes. No rollback required.
maya: nice quick coordination. lesson: chart sidecars with runtime-sensitive binaries need pre-promotion node-capacity and label checks. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
